items.title_en: Democratizing Robot-Use Agents: A Unified Harness with Open Models
items.title_zh: 让机器人使用智能体平民化：基于开放模型的统一框架
items.abstract_en: Robot-use Agents (RUAs) have shown promising zero-shot manipulation capabilities, but reliance on frontier, proprietary models limits research into further training. To democratize RUA research, we introduce uni-robot-agent, a unified harness for competitive open-weight robot use that supports further training. Without privileged inputs, an out-of-the-box Qwen3.8-Flash-Next achieves a RoboDojo Score of 31.39, surpassing the published GPT-6 Astra-RoboProbe result of 28.97 and many VLA/WAM baselines, and performs competitively on 19 real-world tasks. Our analysis across model generations, families, and sizes links effective robot use to four general capabilities, suggesting that future RUA training should develop them jointly.
items.abstract_zh: 机器人使用智能体（RUA）已展现出有前景的零样本操作能力，但对前沿闭源模型的依赖限制了进一步训练研究。为推动 RUA 研究普及化，我们提出 uni-robot-agent——一个支持后续训练、面向开源权重机器人使用的统一框架（harness）。在无特权输入条件下，开箱即用的 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 取得 31.39 的 RoboDojo 分数，超过已发表的 GPT-6 Astra-RoboProbe 的 28.97 以及众多 VLA/WAM 基线，并在 19 个真实世界任务上表现具竞争力。我们跨模型代际、家族与规模的分析将有效的机器人使用归结为四项通用能力，提示未来 RUA 训练应联合培养这些能力。
items.highlight_zh: 开源模型开箱即得 31.39，超越闭源 GPT-6 基线
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：机器人“使用智能体”（RUA）能零样本操控机器人，但主流方案依赖少数闭源前沿模型，学界难以在其上继续训练、复现与改进，形成门槛。
方法：作者发布 uni-robot-agent，一个统一的开放框架，既提供标准化接口让开源权重模型直接驱动机器人，也支持后续训练；评测刻意不使用特权输入（如额外传感器或真值状态）。
结果：开箱即用的 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 在 RoboDojo 基准得 31.39 分，高于已发表的闭源 GPT-6 Astra-RoboProbe 的 28.97，并超过多种 VLA/WAM 基线；在 19 个真实世界任务上表现具竞争力。作者进一步跨模型代际、家族与规模做分析，把有效的“机器人使用”归结为四项通用能力，并发现这些能力应协同发展。
为何重要：它说明开源模型不依赖闭源前沿模型也能达到甚至超过现有水平，为社区提供了可训练、可复现的基座；同时指出未来 RUA 训练应联合培养这四项能力，而非只优化单一指标。

rm.usage: 这是一个面向开放权重机器人的使用智能体统一框架；它与 RoboMaster 赛项关联较弱，只有其“工具、反馈、记忆、恢复”的分层智能体结构可借鉴到工程机器人装配或哨兵高层决策的流程组织，无法直接用于自瞄、导航等实时算法。

items.title_en: NorthCUA Technical Report: Turbocharging Computer-Use Agents through Experience at Scale
items.title_zh: NorthCUA 技术报告：以规模化经验为计算机使用智能体提速
items.abstract_en: Scaling computer-use agents from individual actions to complex software work requires experience that connects decisions to complete outcomes. We present NorthCUA, an integrated system for turbocharging computer-use agents through experience at scale. Its Experience Flywheel supplies diverse executable tasks to the NorthCUA Harness, which sustains long interactions, records decisions, and checks task outcomes. The Flywheel uses these records to curate verified trajectories. For unsolved tasks, recursive self-improvement evolves reusable skills and preserves verified milestones so later attempts build on earlier progress. Staged Learning combines this experience with grounding data from the Flywheel to develop GUI competence through mid-training and long-horizon supervised fine-tuning. The policy then learns from fresh attempts in the same Harness through joint desktop-web reinforcement learning, closing the loop between experience production and policy improvement. The resulting Nano, Mini, and Pro family achieves state-of-the-art results among open-source models across GUI grounding, desktop execution, and Web interaction under the reported evaluation settings. For more responsive Web workflows, NorthCUA-Ultrafast pairs direct action selection with open-ended generation on pre-RL Nano, offering a measured quality-latency tradeoff. Together, these advances establish NorthCUA as a high-performing model family and a reusable foundation for agents that carry complex software work from intent to completion.
items.abstract_zh: 将计算机使用智能体从单一操作扩展到复杂软件工作，需要能连接决策与完整结果的经验。我们提出 NorthCUA 集成系统：其“经验飞轮”向 NorthCUA Harness 提供多样化可执行任务，Harness 维持长程交互、记录决策并校验结果，据此筛选出经过验证的轨迹；未解决任务通过递归自我改进演化可复用技能并保留已验证里程碑。分阶段学习结合 grounding 数据进行中期训练与长程监督微调，再以桌面—网页联合强化学习闭环改进策略。Nano、Mini、Pro 系列在 GUI grounding、桌面执行与 Web 交互上取得开源模型最优结果，NorthCUA-Ultrafast 则提供可度量的质量—延迟权衡。
items.highlight_zh: 经验飞轮闭环，开源 CUA 三项基准达 SOTA
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：让计算机使用智能体（CUA）从“点几下按钮”扩展到完成整段复杂软件工作，关键瓶颈是缺乏能把每一步决策与最终成败对应起来的经验数据。
方法：NorthCUA 是一套集成系统。经验飞轮持续产出多样化可执行任务；Harness 负责执行长程交互、记录每步决策并判定任务成败，据此筛出经过验证的轨迹。对未解决的任务，递归自我改进会演化出可复用技能，并保留已验证的中间里程碑，让下一次尝试从已有进展继续。分阶段学习把这类经验与飞轮的 grounding 数据结合，通过中期训练和长程监督微调建立 GUI 能力；最后在同一 Harness 中用桌面—网页联合强化学习，用新产生的尝试反过来改进策略，形成闭环。
结果：由此得到的 Nano、Mini、Pro 三档模型，在报告的评测设定下，GUI grounding、桌面执行与 Web 交互三项均为开源最优；NorthCUA-Ultrafast 在未做 RL 的 Nano 上以直接动作选择加开放式生成，提供可度量的质量—延迟权衡，适合更强调响应速度的 Web 流程。
为何重要：它把“经验生产”与“策略改进”连成一个可自我强化的循环，既给出高性能模型家族，也给出可复用的智能体基础，使复杂软件工作能从意图推进到完成。

rm.usage: 这是计算机使用/GUI 智能体系统，与 RoboMaster 的机器人感知与控制无直接关系；其“经验飞轮+长程轨迹校验”思路对算法仿真数据生成只有很弱的参考价值，基本用不上。

items.title_en: ReVA-HPE: Relative 6DoF Head Pose Estimation with Synthetic Pose Supervision and Personalized Virtual Anchors
items.title_zh: ReVA-HPE：基于合成姿态监督与个性化虚拟锚点的相对 6DoF 头部姿态估计
items.abstract_en: Monocular head pose estimation is usually formulated as absolute regression from a single face crop, yet many applications observe the same person over time and can supply an explicit anchor image. Recently, relative head pose estimation was proposed, which casts the problem as estimation of the relative geometric change between an anchor and a query image. However, existing methods still require the anchor image pose to be known at inference, significantly limiting their practical use. We first extend relative head pose estimation to full 6DoF by additionally predicting a depth-normalized relative translation, which composes with the anchor to recover metric query pose in the camera frame. To eliminate the need for a ground-truth anchor pose, we reconstruct a personalized avatar from a single unlabeled enrollment image and render a bank of virtual anchors with known poses. The bank provides robust rotation hypotheses through multi-anchor consensus, while the real enrollment image serves as the real anchor in the translation branch via landmark PnP. We also introduce an efficient variant that amortizes the bank cost once at enrollment, after which each query requires a single real-to-real relative prediction, with limited accuracy sacrifice. The relative pose estimator is trained exclusively on synthetic face renderings, without real pose supervision, pseudo-labels, domain adaptation, or fine-tuning on the evaluation sets. On real 6DoF benchmarks, ReVA-HPE achieves state-of-the-art rotation accuracy on BIWI and, given a near-frontal enrollment image, on FaMoS, while remaining competitive in metric translation despite relying solely on synthetic pose supervision. Project page and code: https://vasilikivas.github.io/ReVA-HPE/
items.abstract_zh: 单目头部姿态估计通常建模为对单张人脸裁剪的绝对回归，但许多应用会持续观察同一人，可提供明确的锚定图像。相对头部姿态估计把问题转为估计锚定与查询图像之间的相对几何变化，然而现有方法在推理时仍需已知锚定姿态。我们将相对估计扩展到完整 6DoF，额外预测深度归一化的相对平移，与锚定组合即可恢复相机坐标系下的度量姿态。为免去真实锚定姿态，我们从单张无标注注册图重建个性化虚拟化身，渲染一簇已知姿态的虚拟锚点：多锚共识给出稳健旋转假设，真实注册图经 landmark PnP 充当平移分支的真实锚点；并提出在注册时一次性摊销锚点开销的高效变体。估计器仅用合成人脸渲染训练，不用真实姿态监督、伪标签、域适应或评测集微调。在 BIWI 与 FaMoS 上取得最优旋转精度，度量平移亦具竞争力。
items.highlight_zh: 免真值锚定姿态的 6DoF 相对头姿估计，纯合成数据训练
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：单目头姿估计一般被当作“单张人脸图直接回归绝对姿态”，但很多场景其实长期观察同一个人，能额外提供一张锚定照片——于是“相对头姿”更合适。然而已有相对方法在推理时仍要求知道锚定图的真实姿态，实用性大打折扣，且只处理旋转。
方法：作者先把相对估计扩展到完整 6DoF，多预测一个深度归一化的相对平移，与锚定组合即可还原相机坐标系下的度量姿态。为摆脱对真值锚定姿态的依赖，他们用一张无标注注册照片重建个性化虚拟化身，渲染出一簇姿态已知的虚拟锚点：多个虚拟锚点投票（多锚共识）给出稳健的旋转假设，而真实注册图则通过 landmark PnP 为平移分支提供真实锚点。另有一个高效变体，把锚点簇的开销在注册时一次性算好，此后每次查询只做一次真实到真实的相对预测，精度损失有限。训练全部使用合成人脸渲染，不使用真实姿态标注、伪标签、域适应或在评测集上微调。
结果：在真实 6DoF 基准上，BIWI 以及给定近正面注册图的 FaMoS 上旋转精度达到最优；尽管只靠合成监督，度量平移仍具竞争力。
为何重要：它同时解决了“推理需真值锚定姿态”和“缺真实标注”两个落地障碍，适合部署在个人设备这类能长期观察同一用户的场景。

rm.usage: 这是单目头部 6DoF 相对姿态估计，与 RoboMaster 任务几乎无关；其虚拟锚点/合成监督思路或可类比工程装配中的相对位姿估计，但人脸域差异大，实用度低。

items.title_en: VerifLM: Physically Verified Image-Edit-Guided Goal Pose Generation for Robotic Manipulation
items.title_zh: VerifLM：面向机器人操作的经物理验证的图像编辑引导目标姿态生成
items.abstract_en: Many manipulation goals are easier to visualize than to specify numerically through explicit geometric constraints. We present VerifLM, a framework that converts image-edited goal configurations into physically verified 6-DoF object poses for planning. Using an edited image, VerifLM recovers an initial relative pose between an active object and a passive object, then prompts a vision-language model to generate axis-wise sampling constraints and a task-specific validation program. Candidate poses are evaluated in a physics simulator, and the VLM selects the most task-consistent retained candidate. To operate without predefined object meshes or physical parameters, VerifLM reconstructs metric object geometry from RGB-D observations and constructs multiple hypothetical simulations with varying physics and geometry. Parallel-world validation evaluates candidates across geometry--physics variations and ranks them by the number of worlds in which they satisfy the validation program. We evaluate VerifLM on nine manipulation tasks. VerifLM achieves the highest task success on eight of nine tasks, with the largest performance gain on goals requiring precise orientation and contact relationships.
items.abstract_zh: 许多操作目标更易通过可视化表达，而非用显式几何约束给出数值。我们提出 VerifLM，把图像编辑得到的目标构型转换为经物理验证的 6-DoF 物体姿态以用于规划。给定编辑后的图像，VerifLM 先恢复主动物体与被动目标物体之间的初始相对姿态，再提示视觉语言模型生成逐轴采样约束和任务相关的验证程序。候选姿态在物理仿真器中评估，VLM 从中选出最符合任务的保留候选。为摆脱预定义物体网格与物理参数，VerifLM 从 RGB-D 观测重建度量物体几何，并构建多组物理与几何各异的假设仿真；平行世界验证在几何—物理变化下评估候选，并按满足验证程序的世界数量排序。在九个操作任务上，VerifLM 在其中八个取得最高任务成功率，且在需要精确朝向与接触关系的目标上提升最大。
items.highlight_zh: 图像编辑目标经平行世界物理验证，9 任务 8 胜
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：很多机器人操作的目标“画出来比写成参数容易”——用户能说出要摆成什么样，却难以给出精确的几何约束数值。问题于是变成：如何把一张编辑后的目标图片，转成规划器可用的、物理上站得住的 6-DoF 目标姿态。
方法：VerifLM 先根据编辑图恢复主动物体与被动参照物之间的初始相对姿态；再让视觉语言模型（VLM）生成逐轴采样约束，以及一段针对具体任务的验证程序。候选姿态被丢进物理仿真器中试跑，由 VLM 挑出最符合任务的幸存候选。为摆脱预定义物体网格和物理参数，它从 RGB-D 观测重建度量尺度的物体几何，并构建多组几何与物理假设各不相同的仿真——“平行世界”验证，最后按候选在多少个世界中通过验证程序来排序。
结果：在九个操作任务上，VerifLM 在其中八个取得最高任务成功率；增益最大的是那些需要精确朝向与接触关系的目标。
为何重要：它把“图像编辑”这种直观的人机接口与物理仿真的严格校验结合起来，减少了对人工建模和精确约束标注的依赖，使以可视化的方式指定操作目标变得可行。

rm.usage: 可把“用编辑图像表达目标构型→恢复 6-DoF 物体位姿→在仿真中做物理验证”这套流程用于工程机器人视觉装配：给定装配目标示意，生成能量单元或 42mm 发射机构的抓取与安装位姿，并在仿真中校验接触关系和朝向。

items.title_en: Latent Spectral Prompting for Multimodal Hyperspectral Object Tracking
items.title_zh: 用于多模态高光谱目标跟踪的潜在光谱提示
items.abstract_en: Hyperspectral videos provide rich spectral signatures for robust tracking under challenging conditions such as camouflage and low illumination. However, limited hyperspectral annotations and the large RGB-hyperspectral domain gap hinder the direct use of modern temporally pretrained RGB trackers. We propose SProTrack, a multimodal framework that transfers temporal knowledge from pretrained RGB trackers to the hyperspectral domain through latent spectral prompting. The key idea is to decouple temporal modeling from spectral adaptation, allowing temporal dynamics to be inherited from RGB foundation models while hyperspectral information is learned from unlabeled data in a self-supervised manner. Unlike band-selection methods that discard most spectral information or prompt-based approaches that rely on local-search crops, SProTrack learns a global, scene-level spectral representation from the full hyperspectral frame using an autoencoder. This latent representation is used to guide spectral prompt extraction while a pretrained RGB tracker preserves strong temporal modeling on RGB-compatible inputs. By encoding spectral-spatial structure into compact latent prompts, SProTrack bridges the RGB-hyperspectral modality gap without extensive retraining or dense supervision. Experiments on HOT2020 and HOT2023 demonstrate that SProTrack achieves the best overall performance, with strong results across all spectral domains.
items.abstract_zh: 高光谱视频能在伪装、低照度下提供丰富光谱信息，但标注稀缺且RGB与高光谱域差异大，难以直接使用预训练RGB跟踪器。SProTrack用潜在光谱提示把RGB跟踪器的时序知识迁移到高光谱域，将时序建模与光谱适应解耦：时序继承自RGB基础模型，光谱信息以自监督方式从无标注数据学习。方法用自编码器从完整高光谱帧学习全局场景级光谱表示并引导提示提取。在HOT2020和HOT2023上总体性能最佳。
items.highlight_zh: 解耦时序建模与光谱适应，自监督桥接RGB—高光谱
items.digest_zh: 研究问题：高光谱视频每个像素有大量光谱通道，能区分颜色相近但材质不同的目标，适合伪装和暗光跟踪；但高光谱标注少，且与常见RGB视频差异大，直接套用RGB预训练跟踪器效果受限。方法：SProTrack不微调整个RGB跟踪器，而是先保留其时序建模能力，再用自编码器把整帧高光谱压缩成“场景级潜在光谱表示”，由它生成光谱提示并注入跟踪网络；光谱部分用无标签数据自监督学习。这样把“怎么随时间跟踪”和“怎么利用光谱”分开学。结果：在HOT2020、HOT2023基准上总体最优，跨不同光谱域都稳定。意义：减少对昂贵高光谱标注和密集监督的依赖，为把成熟RGB时序模型迁移到高光谱感知提供可复用思路。
items.comment: Accepted at the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV 2027)

rm.usage: 这是高光谱视频目标跟踪，RoboMaster 相机为普通 RGB、无高光谱数据；其“时序与光谱解耦”思路不能直接用于装甲板跟踪，关联很弱。

items.title_en: TERA: Task-Evidence Restoration for Underwater Object Detection under Bandwidth-Constrained Transmission
items.title_zh: TERA：带宽受限传输下面向水下目标检测的任务证据恢复
items.abstract_en: Underwater object detectors are typically evaluated on pre-transmission images, overlooking additional degradation from bandwidth-constrained downscaling and compression. We introduce AquaTX, a controlled benchmark built from real underwater detection datasets with seen and held-out codecs. We also propose TERA, a metadata-blind receiver-side framework combining task-guided pixel restoration and dual-state feature correction while keeping the detector frozen. Under seen compound degradation, TERA improves mean average precision (mAP50:95, averaged over IoU thresholds from 0.50 to 0.95) from 37.7 to 50.0 on DUO-TX and from 31.5 to 41.3 on RUOD-TX relative to the frozen detector without restoration. TERA also preserves clean-input performance and remains competitive with detector fine-tuning under the held-out AVIF codec. These findings support transmission-aware evaluation and task-guided restoration for underwater object detection. Code is available at https://github.com/hijinkim/TERA.
items.abstract_zh: 水下目标检测器通常在上传前图像上评估，忽略带宽受限下采样与压缩造成的额外退化。作者构建含已见与留出编解码器的AquaTX基准，并提出TERA：不依赖元数据的接收端框架，在检测器冻结下结合任务引导像素恢复与双状态特征校正。在已见复合退化下，TERA把DUO-TX的mAP50:95从37.7提高到50.0、RUOD-TX从31.5提高到41.3；在留出AVIF编解码器下保持干净输入性能，并与微调相当。
items.highlight_zh: 冻结检测器，任务引导恢复提升受限传输水下检测
items.digest_zh: 研究问题：水下图像从相机传到岸上或水面平台时，带宽有限，常需缩小和压缩；现有检测器多在未传输的清晰图上评测，部署后精度会明显下降。方法：作者先建立AquaTX基准，用真实水下检测数据集模拟“已见”和“留出”编解码器造成的复合退化；再提出TERA，在接收端工作且不需要传输元数据，检测器本身保持冻结。TERA包含两部分：按检测任务引导的像素恢复，以及双状态特征校正，尽量把退化图像“修回”到有利于检测的状态。结果：在已见复合退化下，DUO-TX的mAP50:95由37.7升至50.0，RUOD-TX由31.5升至41.3；在未参与训练的AVIF编解码器下仍保持干净图性能，并接近检测器微调。意义：提示水下检测应把传输过程纳入评测，并给出无需重训检测器的实用恢复方案。

rm.usage: 它针对带宽受限下采样/压缩造成的检测退化，在接收端做任务引导的图像恢复与特征校正；可借鉴到 RoboMaster 图传图像经压缩、低码率时提升装甲板检测鲁棒性（检测器冻结时叠加轻量恢复模块）。

items.title_en: TinyAstral: Transferring Self-Evolving Harnesses to Tiny Generalist Manipulation Agents
items.title_zh: TinyAstral：将自进化驾驭框架迁移至小型通用操作智能体
items.abstract_en: Robot agents built on vision-language models depend on both the planner and its harness: the tools, feedback, memory, and recovery logic around it. Can improvements to a large teacher's harness be carried into a compact agent with lower inference compute cost? We present TinyAstral, a two-stage approach. We first freeze an open-weight teacher and improve its harness through recursive self-improvement (RSI): frontier LLM agents read the teacher's trajectories and propose harness edits, and each edit is accepted only if it passes a paired statistical test. We then freeze the final harness, collect teacher trajectories with reasoning and failure recovery, and distill a small student that replaces the teacher in the same harness. On RoboTwin, harness evolution raises the teacher's success from 33.4% to 63.6%; the final 4B student reaches 62.8%. Across four harness versions, distilled 4B students score close to their corresponding teachers, and later versions yield stronger students, showing that harness evolution gains carry into compact models. The harness gains also transfer to other frozen planners without retraining. On identical episodes, the final 4B student outperforms open 4B agents, the open 27B harness-RSI model SenseNova-RoboRSI, and our own teacher model placed in three competitors' harnesses. It stays close to its teacher on all three training benchmarks, and on three benchmarks never used for RSI or training it scores close to a 552B planner running the same harness. On the measured deployment episodes, it uses about one fifth of its teacher's accelerator time.

rm.usage: 这是把大型操作智能体的驾驭框架（harness）迁移到小型通用操作智能体的工作，与 RoboMaster 实时自瞄/导航无直接关系；仅对仿真中训练高层操作策略有很弱的参考。

items.title_en: RadPose: ISAC-based RF 3D Human Pose Estimation
items.title_zh: RadPose：基于ISAC的射频3D人体姿态估计
items.abstract_en: Human pose estimation under adverse lighting and occlusion conditions remains challenging for camera- and LiDAR-based systems. Although mmWave radars provide robustness to illumination and occlusion, they rely on dedicated hardware and licensed spectrum, limiting scalability. In this paper, we present RadPose, a learning-based monostatic integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) framework that enables mmWave communication devices to perform 3D human pose estimation. Unlike specialized radars, RadPose leverages monostatic full-duplex operation to extract channel impulse responses (CIRs) directly from standard OFDM communication signals, generating 3D radio point clouds without additional sensing hardware. To address the sparsity and noise of RF observations, RadPose employs a cross-frame transformer-based pose inference network with semantic-guided spatial attention and target-driven temporal attention for robust spatio-temporal aggregation. It further adopts a joint-aware inverse kinematics refinement module based on graph convolution to enforce skeletal topology, bone-length consistency, and anatomical plausibility. Extensive experiments demonstrate RadPose achieves competitive accuracy compared to state-of-the-art radar-based approaches while maintaining robust performance in unseen and occluded scenarios. The dataset and source code are available at https://github.com/Geo-Chou/RadPose.

items.title_en: An Axiomatic Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Open Multi-Agent Systems
items.title_zh: 开放多智能体系统中强化学习的公理化框架
items.abstract_en: Open multi-agent systems, where only a subset of agents are controllable, are central to real-world domains such as smart grids, yet lack a principled foundation for reinforcement learning algorithm design. We study this setting through n-agent ad hoc teamwork (NAHT), a recent framework for learning in open multi-agent environments. We propose an axiomatic framework that derives value function learning from the Shapley axioms (Efficiency, Symmetry and Linearity), treating them as structural constraints rather than heuristic design choices. This formulation builds on a novel NAHT decomposition, which characterises the fundamental difference between open and fully controllable multi-agent systems, and establishes a cooperative game-theoretic foundation for learning. We further show that enforcing these axioms on learning individual value functions recovers the Shapley value for Dec-POMDPs, providing a principled bridge between reinforcement learning and classical cooperative game theory. Building on this framework, we introduce Shapley Machines and Banzhaf Machines, two generic algorithmic templates that can be instantiated with standard reinforcement learning methods. When applied to strong base algorithms such as IPPO and POAM, our methods consistently improve learning efficiency and generalisation to unseen agent types and conventions across NAHT benchmark tasks. The code of experiments is published on https://github.com/hsvgbkhgbv/axiomatic-rl-naht.

rm.usage: 面向只有部分智能体可控的开放多智能体系统做 RL 设计的公理化框架，理论上可类比哨兵只能接收雷达数据、队友行为不可控的 ad hoc teamwork 场景，但结论停留在价值函数分解的公理层面，落地到 RM 多机协同还需要大量改造。

items.title_en: ForceLDM: A Force-aware Latent Dynamics Model for Contact-Rich Manipulation
items.title_zh: ForceLDM：面向接触丰富操作的力量感知隐动力学模型
items.abstract_en: Contact-rich manipulation requires fine-grained control and complex physical interactions with the environment, posing significant challenges for robot policy learning. Vision-only policies struggle with such tasks, as contact states and interaction forces are difficult to infer from visual observations alone. Existing methods mitigate this issue by incorporating force or tactile sensing. However, they often treat these signals as auxiliary observations without fully exploiting their role in modeling future interaction dynamics. To address this, we propose ForceLDM, a force-aware latent dynamics model that learns future contact and motion dynamics to guide action generation. Rather than directly predicting future observations, which can entangle task-relevant dynamics with irrelevant sensory details, ForceLDM learns a compact representation of future dynamics through knowledge distillation. Specifically, a teacher network with privileged future force/torque and optical flow signals extracts future dynamic features, which are then distilled into a student network trained only on current observations. This enables the student model to reason about upcoming contacts and physical dynamics without relying on future sensory inputs at deployment. To improve robustness and generalization, we further introduce a curriculum-based progressive noise injection strategy to mitigate over-reliance on future features. Experiments on five real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks demonstrate that ForceLDM outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, generalizes effectively to novel objects, and remains robust to environmental perturbations. Project page and code are available at https://tpy001.github.io/ForceLDM/.

items.title_en: The Cost of Mismatch: Noise Amplification in Zeroth-Order Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 失配的代价：零阶强化学习中的噪声放大
items.abstract_en: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization has emerged as a promising approach for memory-efficient large language model (LLM) post-training, yet its reliable application to reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) remains largely unexplored. Motivated by the distinct data regimes of on-policy RL and fixed-data optimization, we develop a generic variance-theoretic framework to investigate what limits the reliability of ZO gradient estimation. Our analysis reveals that estimation reliability is structurally determined by whether the two finite-difference evaluations are performed on matched data. On-policy reinforcement learning (RL) under the mismatched-data regime produces a $1/μ^2$ oracle-noise amplification that sets an irreducible noise floor as the perturbation scale $μ$ decreases, whereas Boltzmann Targeted SFT (BOLT) under the matched-data regime eliminates this amplification via noise cancellation. We further derive convergence guarantees with explicit constants that cleanly separate the two regimes. These results naturally lead to ZO-BOLT, which applies ZO optimization to BOLT's RLVR-aligned weighted-SFT objective. Controlled perturbation-scale sweeps and matched-versus-mismatched end-to-end comparisons validate the predicted effect of data matching. Experiments across three model variants and two mathematical reasoning benchmarks further show that ZO-BOLT consistently improves over the pretrained baseline while retaining a near-inference memory footprint. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/lianmin-chen/the_cost_of_mismatch.
items.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (Poster). 31 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Code is available at https://github.com/lianmin-chen/the_cost_of_mismatch

items.title_en: MIRA: Reinforcing Multimodal Reasoning via Deceptive Contextual Augmentation
items.title_zh: MIRA：通过欺骗性上下文增强强化多模态推理
items.abstract_en: While Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has significantly advanced multimodal reasoning, existing frameworks suffer from a critical "perception-reasoning gap." Due to an over-reliance on seemingly relevant visual tokens, even minor perceptual perturbations can propagate through the reasoning process, leading to compounding hallucinations. To address this issue, we propose MIRA, a training framework that improves robustness to erroneous visual contexts while enhancing logical reasoning ability. By injecting filtered, deceptive visual contexts during training, we construct challenging "hard traps" that stress-test the model's robustness to misleading information. Furthermore, we introduce a group-wise reflection-triggering mechanism that enables the model to autonomously detect and rectify inconsistencies between visual cues and logical constraints, which is ultimately internalized as an intrinsic policy behavior. Importantly, MIRA does not rely on human annotations. Experimental results across multiple reasoning and perception benchmarks show that MIRA yields an average 7% improvement on in-domain benchmarks, with consistent improvements on vision-centric benchmarks. These findings highlight that active error recovery is essential for robust multimodal reasoning. Comprehensive ablation studies and analyses further provide insights into why MIRA is effective.

items.title_en: Iterative Gumbel Planning for Continuous Control
items.title_zh: 用于连续控制的迭代Gumbel规划
items.abstract_en: Search-based planning remains a powerful policy improvement paradigm in reinforcement learning, driving milestone successes in discrete domains. However, extending this paradigm to continuous control exposes a structural mismatch: search evaluates a finite set of action candidates, whereas continuous RL typically relies on Gaussian policies. We show that winner-action distillation into a continuous Gaussian induces a \textit{projection error} and a stepwise variance-expanding gradient tendency when the selected action is sufficiently far from the current mean. Empirically, this tendency is associated with elevated terminal variance and a return gap on the evaluated tasks. To address this, we propose \textbf{Iterative Gumbel Planning (IGP)}. By adopting a per-dimension factorized categorical policy, IGP naturally aligns the policy support with the search candidates, eliminating the projection error and reducing the residual approximation to a bounded discretization error. To bypass the combinatorial explosion of high-dimensional discrete action spaces, IGP pairs Gumbel Top-$K$ candidate sampling with an MPPI-style multi-round iterative search to refine the policy at each state. Empirically, IGP achieves state-of-the-art aggregate performance and sample efficiency on DMControl and HumanoidBench. Furthermore, it produces more stable action sequences with lower temporal variance, demonstrating its practical potential for real-world robotic deployment.

items.title_en: EgoMo3R: Joint Egocentric Motion and Scene Reconstruction
items.title_zh: EgoMo3R：联合自我中心运动与场景重建
items.abstract_en: Understanding holistic 3D human motion and the surrounding environment from egocentric video is fundamental for applications in AR/VR and robotics. Although these tasks are inherently coupled, existing methods treat them separately. In particular, egocentric motion reconstruction methods typically assume access to metric, gravity-aligned camera trajectories from specialized inertial sensors. Recovering such trajectories from monocular egocentric video remains a significant challenge due to rapid head movements and motion blur. We present EgoMo3R, a joint optimization framework that simultaneously reconstructs 3D human motion and scene geometry from casual egocentric video. It leverages the robustness of low-level visuo-geometric primitives, including monocular depth, optical flow, and point tracks, integrated with a diffusion-based human motion prior via first-order optimization. We propose an alternating optimization scheme that establishes a synergistic feedback loop: scene reconstruction provides physical grounding and trajectory conditioning for the motion prior, while the motion prior regularizes the camera trajectory and anchors the scene in a metric, gravity-aligned world frame. We evaluate EgoMo3R on the highly dynamic sequences of the EgoExo4D and Nymeria datasets and show that it outperforms specialized baselines in both 3D scene reconstruction and egocentric motion estimation.

items.title_en: WorkIng: A Real-World and Synthetic Highway Work-Zone Benchmark Dataset for Autonomous Navigation
items.title_zh: WorkIng：面向自主导航的真实世界与合成公路作业区基准数据集
items.abstract_en: Highway work zones are critical edge cases for autonomous vehicles (AVs), combining atypical geometries and jurisdiction-specific regulations that existing benchmarks fail to capture: real-world datasets lack 360° multi-modal, full-scene 3D work zone annotation, and no single recorded site can span the layouts and regulatory variants needed for generalizable models. We present WorkIng, a dual-domain benchmark and training resource. WorkIng-Highway provides a 360° multi-modal work zone benchmark with synchronized 128-channel LiDAR, six RGB cameras, and RTK-GPS across 32 km, yielding 12,000+ annotated frames and 227,399 tracked 3D bounding boxes. WorkIng-CARLA complements this with procedural simulation spanning 24 regulation-aware scenarios across six canonical topologies and six international traffic standards, populated by 100+ custom 3D assets. Benchmarking representative 3D detection and end-to-end planning architectures shows that real-world data remains the primary performance driver, and that scenario-stratified synthetic augmentation improves architectures across 2D recognition, 3D detection, and trajectory planning. Resources: https://github.com/cvims/WorkIng

items.title_en: GRIT: Gradient Masking for Visually Misgrounded Tokens in Text-Rich Reasoning
items.title_zh: GRIT：面向文本丰富推理中视觉错误接地Token的梯度掩蔽
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has recently been extended to vision-language models (VLMs), yet its effectiveness remains limited for text-rich reasoning tasks. We highlight a key factor contributing to this limitation: models frequently arrive at correct final answers despite misperceiving visual information during intermediate steps. We define this phenomenon as Correct-but-Visually-Misgrounded Reasoning (CVMR). Because standard RLVR rewards only final-answer correctness, it fails to differentiate between properly grounded and misgrounded reasoning, reinforcing both equally. Through token-level analysis, we reveal that CVMR tokens exhibit distinct attention patterns that differ systematically from well-grounded ones. Based on this observation, we propose GRIT, a training framework that incorporates visual grounding into RLVR to mitigate the impact of CVMR. Furthermore, to address the lack of text-rich reasoning benchmarks that allow for systematic evaluation across text length and reasoning depth, we introduce GRIT-Bench. Experiments demonstrate that GRIT significantly improves both reasoning accuracy and grounding fidelity over existing RLVR methods.

items.title_en: Toward Executable Multi-framework Front-end Code Generation with Self-Correction
items.title_zh: 面向可执行多框架前端代码生成的自校正方法
items.abstract_en: Generating codes from UI screenshots has recently benefited from MLLMs, yet existing methods centered on HTML targets and transfer poorly to multi-frameworks such as React, Vue, and Angular. However, unlike HTML, which does not entail compilation issues, generating executable code in multi-framework settings is more challenging due to framework-specific differences in syntax and failure modes, as well as the need to maintain global consistency across files. To address this problem, we study executable multi-framework front-end code generation and propose MESCoder, a tree-structured self-corrective generation framework. Our method first extracts a structural scaffold from the screenshot and then constructs sub-trees and assembly relations step by step, transforming large project generation into a sequence of localized decisions. On top of this scaffold, we introduce a unified Project Agent that continuously revises its own partial project under runtime sandbox feedback and dynamically chooses between local repair and cluster level repair. For training, we adopt a two-stage strategy that first initializes the policy offline to learn basic multi-framework generation and repair priors, and then refines it with online reinforcement learning to optimize long horizon executability and final page quality. The resulting framework models multi-framework executability as a conditioned project state transition process and improves the stability and quality of complex front end generation through self correction. Experiments show that our method improves executability, while narrowing the visual-fidelity gap to HTML-based generation. Code is available at https://github.com/leo-lilinxiao/MESCoder.

items.title_en: Learning to Group and Order: Cross-Instance Self-Supervised RL for Vision-Centric MLLMs
items.title_zh: 学习分组与排序：面向视觉中心MLLM的跨实例自监督强化学习
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training has become an important paradigm for improving multimodal large language models (MLLMs), especially with automatically verifiable rewards. Self-supervised visual pretext tasks provide such rewards without human annotations. However, existing methods mainly exploit within-instance structure, offering limited supervision for cross-instance discrimination and fine-grained comparison. We introduce Group-and-Order Self-Supervised Reinforcement Learning (GO-SSL), a cross-instance jigsaw framework for vision-centric MLLM post-training. Given two visual instances, GO-SSL mixes their local elements and trains the model to group them by instance of origin while recovering the order within each group, coupling instance-level comparison with spatial, temporal, or geometric structure recovery. This paired formulation turns the same unlabeled data into richer verifiable supervision through diverse pairings, shuffles, and a random-to-hard curriculum. We instantiate GO-SSL mainly on cross-image jigsaw tasks and further extend it to 3D depth and video temporal ordering. Across diverse benchmarks, GO-SSL consistently improves over the base MLLM and prior self-supervised post-training baselines, with clear gains in fine-grained perception and spatial understanding. Further evaluations across model scales and families support its generality. These results suggest that cross-instance comparison provides a useful self-supervised RL signal for improving transferable visual understanding in MLLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/SEU-VIPGroup/GO-SSL.

rm.usage: 该工作研究视觉中心 MLLM 的跨实例自监督强化学习，仅在通用多模态模型后训练层面有参考性；RoboMaster 自瞄/装配的视觉模型通常是小模型+检测跟踪，难以直接套用。

items.title_en: Pixel-UMI: Learning Environment-Aware Whole-Body Manipulation from Sensorized Human Demonstrations
items.title_zh: Pixel-UMI：从传感器化人类演示中学习环境感知的全身操作
items.abstract_en: Sensorized human demonstrations offer scalable data for mobile manipulation, but embodiment differences complicate policy learning. We present Pixel-UMI, a pipeline for learning environment-aware whole-body policies from human data. We first introduce Environment-Aware Retargeting (EAR), which combines reconstructed scene geometry with demonstrated head and gripper trajectories to determine robot posture and generate collision-aware joint and base targets. Delay-calibrated action assignment converts these trajectories into actions. However, kinematic differences can leave residual pose errors, creating viewpoint mismatches between human demonstrations and robot observations. We therefore introduce Retargeting-Error-Aware Masking (REAM), which uses these errors during training to reduce reliance on mismatched views at deployment. Finally, because estimated actions cannot fully capture contact-rich interactions, we collect on-policy human corrections through DAgger to improve performance. We evaluate Pixel-UMI on five challenging tasks spanning articulated-object manipulation, deformable-object handling, constrained-space reaching, whole-body collision avoidance, and contact-rich bimanual coordination, achieving 87.0% average task progress. Video results are available at https://pixel-robot.com/pixel-umi

items.title_en: Pixel: A Co-Designed Full-Stack Robot System for Learning General-Purpose Mobile Manipulation
items.title_zh: Pixel：一个协同设计的全栈机器人系统，用于学习通用移动操作
items.abstract_en: General-purpose mobile manipulation requires a combination of capable robot hardware, scalable demonstration collection, expressive whole-body control, and effective policy learning. Yet these components are often developed independently, creating mismatches that limit the capabilities of the complete system. We present Pixel, a co-designed full-stack system for learning general-purpose mobile manipulation. Pixel combines a low-cost wheeled humanoid with human-aligned kinematics and compliant grippers, multiple teleoperation and robot-free human data-collection interfaces, a unified whole-body controller, and a common policy learning pipeline across human and robot demonstrations. A hierarchical learning stack further enables language-conditioned visuomotor control and long-horizon task execution. We evaluate the system across hardware, data collection, and policy learning, and demonstrate mobile-manipulation behaviors requiring dexterity, active perception, navigation, and whole-body coordination. We hope that Pixel provides an integrated and extensible foundation for studying how robot hardware, data, control, and learning can be designed together for robot learning. More results at https://pixel-robot.com/pixel

items.title_en: EgoActionBench: Benchmarking Dense Action Captioning for Egocentric Human Videos
items.title_zh: EgoActionBench：面向第一人称人类视频的密集动作描述基准测试
items.abstract_en: Learning from human data offers a scalable path toward embodied intelligence, yet it requires models to accurately understand fine-grained human actions from egocentric observations. However, existing benchmarks remain limited in action atomicity, temporal precision, and hand-action association. We introduce EgoActionBench, a benchmark that represents continuous human manipulation as temporally localized atomic actions associated with the left hand, right hand, or both hands. EgoActionBench contains 1,407 episodes with 41,132 human-refined action annotations. To evaluate such dense predictions, we propose an evaluation protocol that retrieves temporally eligible candidates, selects a prediction by content agreement, and scores semantic fidelity and temporal overlap alongside action precision and recall, jointly capturing what happens, when it happens, and which hand performs it. We benchmark 20 baseline models and systems on EgoActionBench and further adapt two backbones, Qwen3-VL-4B and LLaVA-OneVision-2-8B, through supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning on automatically annotated training episodes. EgoAction improves EgoActionScore by 15.9 and 23.2 points on the two backbones, and both adapted models outperform all open-source baselines. Our experiments reveal substantial limitations of current models in action atomicity, temporal precision, and hand-action association, highlighting the gap between general video understanding and the action understanding required for embodied intelligence.

items.title_en: WebHarbor: Docking Real Websites for Evolving GUI Agent Environments
items.title_zh: WebHarbor：对接真实网站以构建可演化的 GUI 智能体环境
items.abstract_en: GUI web agents require realistic and interactive environments that remain stable during both evaluation and training. Live website evaluation suffers from changing content, access restrictions, and limited coverage of authenticated workflows, while existing synthetic environments for training often lack functional depth and visual fidelity. We propose WebHarbor, a suite of 153 executable and dockerized website environments that faithfully reconstruct the visual interfaces, content, and functional workflows of real-world web services under deterministic control. We build WebHarbor through task-driven human-agent collaboration, where environments evolve as new tasks expand their functional scope, coding agents implement the required changes, and human contributors audit visual fidelity, functional correctness, and task validity. The resulting suite comprises 3,518 tasks spanning multi-step and post-authentication workflows, where existing works often fail to cover. Beyond reliable evaluation, WebHarbor provides high-fidelity synthetic web environments for cost-efficient reinforcement learning (RL). We demonstrate that a Qwen 4B-level GUI agent trained with RL in WebHarbor generalizes to unseen tasks and performs competitively with leading open-source GUI web agents across four benchmarks. The code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/aiming-lab/WebHarbor.

items.title_en: Not All Reasoning Generalizes: A Case Study on Learning Generalizable Reasoning Strategies in RLVR
items.title_zh: 并非所有推理都能泛化：RLVR 中学习可泛化推理策略的案例研究
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) can enable generalizable improvement for large language model (LLM) reasoning. This paper studies how to incentivize such generalization via reasoning strategies. We study this question with a controllable equation-solving framework: finding multiple inputs x for equations f(x)=y, where f is a non-bijective string function. This setting makes reasoning strategies observable while supporting a clear definition of easy-to-hard out-of-distribution (OOD) shifts, e.g., more solutions, longer y, etc. We uncover a subtle RLVR failure: it teaches the model to solve in-distribution tasks with high accuracy and structured step-by-step derivation, yet under OOD shifts, the same model abandons derivation and collapses to ineffective brute-force enumeration, causing sharp accuracy drops. This observation reveals the deeper challenges of RLVR generalization as it is neither incapable base model nor reward hacking, since the model succeeds in-distribution with the correct reasoning strategy. The key to mitigating this failure is an indirect intervention that surprisingly helps: co-training with bijective inversion tasks. Although these bijective tasks are actually not uniformly harder and even further from the non-bijective OOD evaluation, they make derivation more certain and substantially restore the correct strategy and accuracy under OOD shifts. This effect further motivates our theoretical analysis: outcome-only RLVR can shape reasoning processes through implicitly crediting the effective reasoning strategies more, even without process supervision. To conclude, our analysis framework and findings systematically reveal the crucial role and incentivization of reasoning strategies in RLVR generalization under OOD shifts. Code is available at https://github.com/ziqipang/rl_meta_thinking.

rm.usage: 研究 RLVR 下推理策略的泛化与失败模式，可作为仿真中用可验证奖励训练决策/策略时的方法论参考（警惕只学到表面捷径），但不针对 RoboMaster 具体任务。

items.title_en: D&A: Decoupling Description and Assessment Enables VLMs as Zero-Shot Robotic Reward Models
items.title_zh: D&A：解耦描述与评估使 VLM 成为零样本机器人奖励模型
items.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) hold promise for zero-shot video task-progress estimation in robot learning, yet existing frameworks frequently suffer from confirmation bias, hallucinating progress in failed executions due to implicit success assumptions or relative temporal ranking designs. Naive prompting of frontier models collapses into a binary success detector that fails to capture nuanced, non-linear progress and failures. While post-training approaches can mitigate this through explicit training, they demand expensive real-world robotics data and require computationally intensive post-training for every individual base model. To resolve these limitations, we introduce D&A (Describe & Assess): our approach decouples progress estimation into an objective, task-grounded textual description of scene dynamics followed by an assessment phase using explicit rubrics. By compelling the VLM to synthesize an explicit, text-based definition of absolute success before scoring, the framework anchors evaluations to an external, global criterion rather than the video's internal timeline. Empirical results demonstrate that our method calibrates zero-shot estimates and mitigates confirmation bias, providing fine-grained, partial progress metrics that accurately penalize failed executions while correctly interpolating successful runs. Being purely prompt-based, D&A generalizes across tasks, embodiments, and benchmarks---matching or surpassing post-trained reward models---and its reward estimates enable efficient downstream reinforcement learning.

rm.usage: 用 VLM 做零样本任务进度/成功评估作为奖励模型，可用于仿真或实车中为工程装配、多机战术决策等长程任务自动生成奖励与进度打分，缓解人工标注；需自行设计提示与校准，属于支撑性工具。

items.title_en: TAMPAgent: Agentic Belief-Space Planning for Mobile Manipulation
items.title_zh: TAMPAgent：面向移动操作的智能体式信念空间规划
items.abstract_en: Open-world robotic mobile manipulation requires acting in physical environments with only partial information. While recent Large Vision-Language Model (LVLM) agents show strong open-world reasoning capabilities, existing architectures that rely on direct tool calling struggle with geometric uncertainty and thus are limited to fully-observable tabletop environments. In contrast, Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) systems can solve long-horizon tasks under partial observability but incur high computational costs and require closed worlds. We propose \textbf{TAMPAgent}, an agentic planning framework that unifies the reasoning of LVLMs with the structured constraint satisfaction of TAMP systems. We endow an LVLM agent with a belief-space planning model operating over an extensible API of perception, planning, and control tools. The agent formulates a partial task plan composed of parameterized observation and execution actions, which is subsequently completed using classical search algorithms. After extracting the plan's geometric constraints, the agent leverages its tool API to bind valid parameter values, satisfying feasibility requirements and producing an executable motion plan. Upon execution, the agent continuously updates its belief history and repeats this closed-loop process by interleaving observation and manipulation actions. Evaluated across complex household mobile manipulation tasks on Rainbow Y1 and Unitree G1 platforms, TAMPAgent significantly outperforms direct tool-calling agentic baselines, demonstrating that integrating TAMP constraint satisfaction into agentic planning loops is essential for unstructured, partially observable environments.

rm.usage: 与工程机器人视觉装配的直接关联较弱；仅可借鉴其部分可观测下的任务与运动规划思路，用于工程机器人移动至装配位的高层规划，但实时性和封闭场景适配需大幅改造。

items.title_en: PanoTac: A Dense Three-Axis Tactile Sensor for Robust Touch-Centric Manipulation
items.title_zh: PanoTac：一种用于稳健触觉中心操作的密集三轴触觉传感器
items.abstract_en: Contact-rich manipulation benefits from tactile feedback that captures both detailed contact geometry and interaction forces. When scooping grains, contact patterns help infer spoon orientation, while resistance transmitted through the grasp guides motion. To provide these complementary sensing capabilities, we present PanoTac, a low-cost, compliant tactile fingertip designed for dense three-axis tactile sensing. Each fingertip provides a $12 \times 32 \times 3$ tactile representation, with one normal ($z$) and two shear ($x$, $y$) response components at each taxel. The sensor operates at 60 Hz and costs less than $50 per fingertip. Sensor characterization quantifies response repeatability and consistency across sensor instances and contact locations. We integrate PanoTac into a robotic system with a visuo-tactile pipeline. Across test-tube preparation, grain scooping, and salt pouring, the resulting policies outperform vision-only baselines by an average of 46.7 percentage points. Ablations show that removing either spatial contact information or shear feedback reduces overall performance across the task suite. Our project page is available at https://panotac.github.io.

rm.usage: 该触觉传感器面向精细接触操作，而RoboMaster工程装配主要依赖视觉标签和位姿识别，触觉反馈并非必需，直接可用性很低。

items.title_en: When Robots Outweigh Objects: How Inertia Mismatch Shapes Robot Policy Learning
items.title_zh: 当机器人比物体更重时：惯性失配如何塑造机器人策略学习
items.abstract_en: Conventional robot arms can be extremely heavy compared with the everyday objects they manipulate, creating a significant inertia mismatch at contact. Even a small accidental bump from a heavy arm can knock a light object out of place. Modern learning methods have nevertheless demonstrated a wide range of successful manipulation behaviors on these platforms, suggesting that even extreme inertia mismatch can be overcome with sufficient data. However, it remains unclear whether high inertia imposes a hidden cost on learning, potentially worsening scaling with data or lowering the performance ceiling of modern robot learning methods. We investigate this question through controlled simulation experiments that vary robot and object masses. We find that reinforcement learning succeeds across a broad range of mass combinations, while behavior cloning learns more reliable policies when a lighter robot manipulates a heavier object, and more data narrows the resulting gap without closing it. Behavior cloning likewise degrades on a simulated robot arm as its motors reflect more inertia through their gearing, even though its weight stays the same. Finally, because new hardware is rarely an option, we explore ways to lower contact inertia on the arm one already has, either by choosing a lower-inertia workspace before collecting data or by steering the demonstrator toward lower-inertia solutions of the task. In both simulated cases, the lower-inertia demonstrations are imitated more reliably. Project website: https://younghyopark.me/inertia-mismatch/

rm.usage: 讨论机械臂与轻物体惯性失配下的策略学习，与RoboMaster工程视觉装配或自瞄云台控制关系很弱，基本用不上。

items.title_en: SNAP: Semantic Navigation Among Pedestrians
items.title_zh: SNAP：行人间的语义导航
items.abstract_en: Navigating crowded urban environments requires robots to avoid pedestrians while adhering to social norms such as remaining on sidewalks. Existing approaches typically address either crowd avoidance or semantic path planning in isolation. We propose a reinforcement learning (RL) navigation policy that jointly reasons about semantic terrain and dynamic obstacles from a single semantically annotated bird's-eye-view (BEV) map, without relying on explicit human-state estimation. Our policy outperforms established crowd-navigation and semantic-aware baselines and transfers zero-shot to a legged robot, demonstrating socially compliant navigation in highly dynamic real-world scenarios.

rm.usage: 可借鉴其基于语义BEV地图联合动态障碍避让与路径规划的强化学习策略，用于哨兵在赛场内避让敌方机器人和静态障碍；但行人/人行道语义需替换为赛场语义，属于改造使用。

items.title_en: Exploring Proximity and Tactile Sensing for Robotic Manipulation
items.title_zh: 探索用于机器人操作的接近觉与触觉传感
items.abstract_en: Pre-touch sensing, or sensing information about an object before contact, is an attractive modality for robot hands as it can allow a robot to anticipate and respond to a contact before it happens. In this work, we introduce ToFTouch, a multimodal tactile sensor combining three multizone (4$\times$4 resolution) time-of-flight sensors with an optics-based pressure sensing array. We mount this sensor on a parallel jaw gripper and demonstrate its utility on three distinct tasks: (i) pre-grasp adjustment, (ii) item extraction from clutter, and (iii) item insertion into tight spaces. For pre-grasp adjustment, ToF feedback reduced cycle time by 7.4$\%$ by enabling anticipatory gripper closure during approach. For extraction, ToF sensing enabled successful retrieval across all tested depth offsets ($\pm$2 cm) deviating from the nominal pick point, including conditions where baseline approaches failed, with standard deviations below 0.4 cm. For insertion into dense clutter, we explore the proximity and tactile information provided from ToFTouch during an insertion trajectory. The results demonstrate the utility of multizone ToF sensing in a manipulation environment.

rm.usage: 接近觉与触觉传感主要用于抓取前感知，RoboMaster工程装配以视觉位姿识别为主，该传感器方案与赛事任务关联很弱。

items.title_en: Clinician-AI Collaboration in Endovascular Neurointerventions: In-Vitro User Study of Copilot Assistance Modes for Robotic Navigation Across the Autonomy Spectrum
items.title_zh: 血管内神经介入中的临床医生-AI协作：跨自主性谱系的机器人导航副驾驶辅助模式的体外用户研究
items.abstract_en: Mechanical thrombectomy (MT) is an effective treatment for acute ischemic stroke, yet access remains limited by the availability of neurointerventional expertise. Telerobotic and AI-assisted systems may help address this challenge, but it remains unclear how clinicians interact with different levels of autonomy and how autonomous navigation systems perform in realistic environments. This work introduces Copilot Assistance Modes (CAMs), a framework for clinician-AI collaboration in robotic endovascular navigation spanning the autonomy spectrum from manual operation to full autonomy. In the first in-vitro user study comparing clinician-AI collaboration strategies, 11 experts and two students evaluated six navigation modes in a patient-specific vascular phantom. Objective performance metrics were combined with subjective assessments, including workload and usability. Autonomous performance was additionally evaluated both in silico and in vitro to investigate sim-to-real transfer. Hands-on manual navigation achieved the strongest overall performance (100% success). While fully autonomous navigation achieved 81% success in simulation, performance dropped to 23% in vitro. In contrast, several clinician-AI shared-autonomy modes achieved success rates of 92-97%, approximately four times higher than full autonomy and comparable to direct robotic control (95%), demonstrating mitigation of sim-to-real domain shift through clinician-AI collaboration. Among the evaluated AI-driven approaches, user-directed task delegation and rotational shared control demonstrated the most favorable balance between performance and clinician acceptance. These findings suggest that effective clinician-AI collaboration and allocation of control authority may currently be more important for reliable robotic neurointerventional navigation than increasing autonomy alone.

rm.usage: 血管介入导航的人机协作自主性分级与RoboMaster任务差异很大，至多对飞镖或工程机器人的人机接管思路有泛泛参考，实用度很低。

items.title_en: HyperFlow: Class-Incremental Semantic Change Detection via Hyperbolic Flow
items.title_zh: HyperFlow：基于双曲流的类增量语义变化检测
items.abstract_en: Semantic change detection in remote sensing aims to identify and characterize land-cover transitions observed in pairs of satellite or aerial images. Existing methods assume a fixed set of change categories, limiting their applicability in real-world scenarios where changes of interest may vary, for example across geographies or over time. In this work, we tackle the problem of class-incremental semantic change detection, where a model progressively learns to detect new types of semantic change. To do so, we exploit the hierarchical structure of land-cover semantics, where newly introduced categories correspond to fine-grained refinements of existing ones, and represent said semantic categories in hyperbolic space, which is particularly well suited to represent such hierarchical relationships. To capture semantic changes, we introduce HyperFlow, a method relying on Busemann prototypes, modeling change as an anomaly in a learned semantic flow within the hyperbolic embedding space induced by segmentation. HyperFlow couples change detection to class-incremental semantic segmentation, enabling class-incremental semantic change detection. We also present HiChange, a new large-scale, high resolution remote sensing dataset with detailed, fine-grained hierarchical labels. Experimental results demonstrate that HyperFlow achieves both strong change detection and semantic segmentation performance across incremental steps. In particular, we show that progressively refining semantic categories, rather than considering them all directly, yields improved change detection, highlighting the benefits of incremental learning for semantic change detection.

rm.usage: 遥感语义变化检测面向地物类别变化，与RoboMaster雷达目标探测、多目标跟踪或赛场决策均不匹配，关联很弱。

items.title_en: CL3DOD: Understanding the Stability-Plasticity Dilemma in Outdoor Class-Incremental 3D Object Detection
items.title_zh: CL3DOD：理解室外类增量3D目标检测中的稳定性—可塑性困境
items.abstract_en: Class-incremental learning (CIL) for outdoor 3D object detection remains largely underexplored. Existing outdoor studies are limited to single-benchmark evaluations, with SDCoT++ considering KITTI and CL2OD considering nuScenes under different incremental settings. This makes it difficult to assess whether observed continual-learning behavior generalizes across autonomous-driving benchmarks. To the best of our knowledge, we provide the first unified cross-benchmark analysis of outdoor class-incremental 3D object detection across multiple autonomous-driving benchmarks, covering both two-task and multi-stage settings. We investigate: (1) how severely existing 3D detectors forget previously learned classes, (2) how incremental training exposes the stability-plasticity dilemma between knowledge retention and new-class acquisition, and (3) which forms of supervision are most effective for balancing these objectives. We introduce CL3DOD, a class-incremental 3D detection framework that restores missing supervision for previous classes using predictions from the previous-stage detector, preserves old-class responses through query-wise knowledge distillation, and employs EMA-based temporal consistency regularization. Experiments on KITTI and nuScenes reveal a consistent stability-plasticity dilemma across both benchmarks. CL3DOD generally achieves a more favorable stability-plasticity balance than controlled incremental baselines and improves upon published prior methods in the reported benchmark comparisons. This advantage persists across multiple incremental stages, demonstrating strong retention of previously learned knowledge while maintaining effective new-class acquisition. Our code, evaluation setup, and incremental task splits will be publicly released.

rm.usage: 室外3D目标检测的类别增量学习可为雷达/感知系统适应新目标类别提供方法参考，但RoboMaster目标类别固定、场景尺度小，直接收益有限。

items.title_en: MoSoLoco: Monocular 3D Human Localization through Visual Latent Features and Social Context
items.title_zh: MoSoLoco：通过视觉潜在特征与社会上下文实现单目3D人体定位
items.abstract_en: Estimating the metric 3D position of people from a monocular camera is important for robot navigation and motion prediction. Lightweight pose-based localizers are attractive for robotic hardware with limited computational resources because they operate on compact 2D keypoints. However, they typically discard the richer visual representations computed by the pose estimator. We introduce MoSoLoco, a per-frame monocular 3D human localizer that combines the pose detector's internal visual features with the detected 2D skeleton, without requiring an additional RGB or depth encoder. MoSoLoco can further incorporate sparse same-frame multi-person context to refine individual position estimates. Experiments on JRDB and NuScenes show that reusing pose-detector representations improves localization, reducing the best JRDB error by approximately 23 percent relative to the strongest evaluated keypoint-based baseline. A sparse social-interaction module incorporates nearby detections from the same image for further refinement. Controlled trajectory-forecasting experiments show downstream benefits, while the complete pipeline remains suitable for efficient Jetson AGX Xavier inference.

rm.usage: 面向单目相机的行人3D定位，与RM赛场中识别装甲板/机器人目标的问题设定不同（场上无行人、目标是裁判系统灯板），很难直接迁移；最多在单目测距、结合2D关键点的轻量化思路方面提供一点参考。

items.title_en: FineCraft: Enhancing VLA Models for Fine-Grained Manipulation
items.title_zh: FineCraft：增强VLA模型的细粒度操作能力
items.abstract_en: Fine-grained manipulation couples instruction grounding, local visual precision, and sustained execution. We present FineCraft, a framework that adapts pretrained models for fine-grained manipulation in the MetaFine Challenge. A task-routed mixture of policies selects independently adapted DINOv2-DiT or pretrained $π_{0.5}$ policies through a common observation-action interface. Local visual features help identify the instructed object parts, demonstrations and expert continuations teach the required actions, and new observations guide replanning during execution. FineCraft ranks fourth with an overall score of $0.878$, exceeding the published reference on all five tasks. Official results and local diagnostics characterize performance across visual perturbations, instruction changes, and multi-stage manipulation. Code is available at https://github.com/eqcy/FineCraft

rm.usage: 细粒度操作框架（局部视觉特征定位被抓取部位、任务路由的多策略混合、执行中重规划）可作为工程机器人视觉装配的参考：用局部视觉特征精确定位能量单元/42mm发射机构的装配接口，并在机械臂执行过程中根据新观测重规划。但VLA路线算力与训练成本高，需大幅改造。

items.title_en: From PID to Reinforcement Learning in Building HVAC Control: A Control-Architecture Review of Tuning Strategies, Formulations, and Deployment Trade-offs
items.title_zh: 从PID到强化学习：建筑HVAC控制的控制架构综述——调参策略、问题建模与部署权衡
items.abstract_en: This paper reviews control architectures for building heating, ventilation and air-conditioning (HVAC) systems, addressing the tension among energy demand, occupant comfort and equipment operability, and situating proportional-integral-derivative (PID) regulation within a layered control stack that also includes rule-based and model-based supervisory control and data-driven reinforcement learning (RL). It examines the thermostat-PID layer from two-position and scheduled setpoint control through proportional, PI and PID regulation and their tuning, then formulates RL for building control as a Markov decision process. Its central contribution is a taxonomy of where RL meets PID: RL as a gain tuner for an existing loop, as a direct replacement for the regulatory controller, as a hybrid with model predictive control, and as supervisory setpoint and schedule generation. Across these classes, the review establishes that the physical loop remains invariant while the intervention point changes, and that the classes differ in their requirements for actuation authority, state information, modelling, commissioning and constraint handling. It further establishes that PID is inexpensive and well codified but limited by nonlinearity, time variation, discrete mode switching, loop interaction and slow plant dynamics, while RL's admissible position must be argued rather than assumed. The paper concludes that these architectures are not competing philosophies of control but nested points of attachment on one HVAC plant, with hybrid implementations possible, and that deployment trade-offs must be assessed according to the specific control interface and scaffolding required.

rm.usage: 建筑HVAC的PID/规则/RL分层控制综述，与RM的云台控制、导航决策体系只有方法论层面的相似（分层控制+调参），没有直接的赛题落点，关联很弱。

items.title_en: Controlling Sharpening in LLM Post-Training
items.title_zh: 控制LLM后训练中的锐化现象
items.abstract_en: LLM post-training via reinforcement learning has shown consistent improvements in accuracy at the cost of reducing behavioral coverage - a phenomenon known as sharpening that can stall progress on difficult tasks. Repeated sampling objectives such as $\mathrm{pass@k}$ and $\mathrm{max@k}$ are known to mitigate sharpening, but the mechanism behind it remains poorly understood. Moreover, existing approaches for $\mathrm{@k}$ optimization use dedicated algorithms, and no general framework exists for adapting established policy optimization methods from $\mathrm{@}1$ to $\mathrm{@k}$. We derive the optimal policies for KL-regularized $\mathrm{pass@k}$ and $\mathrm{max@k}$ objectives in closed form. Our explicit solutions reveal that $\mathrm{@k}$ optimization naturally redistributes learning pressure based on prompt difficulty, directing it toward harder problems. Crucially, we show that standard $\mathrm{@}1$ objectives achieve these exact same optimal policies through prompt-adaptive regularization or reward transformation. Ultimately, this yields an optimizer-independent explanation for why $\mathrm{@k}$ objectives reduce sharpening on easy tasks while prioritizing success on harder ones. Building on these insights, we introduce $\mathrm{@k}$ Adaptive Pressure for Policy Optimization (KAPPO). Following a one-time reference calibration, KAPPO seamlessly adapts existing $\mathrm{@}1$ methods to $\mathrm{@k}$ via prompt-adaptive regularization or reward transformation, without otherwise altering their training procedures. Experiments with several RL methods on mathematical reasoning and code generation demonstrate that KAPPO provides direct control over sharpening. Crucially, we demonstrate that $\mathrm{@k}$ pressure can be fully realized with single completion training, matching the performance of multi-completion $\mathrm{@k}$ optimizers at a fraction of the cost.

rm.usage: 研究LLM后训练中的锐化与pass@k目标，属于大语言模型训练理论，和RM的自瞄、导航、决策等算法环节基本无关。

items.title_en: KlaskTron: An Open-Source Platform for Physical Adversarial Multi-Agent RL
items.title_zh: KlaskTron：面向物理对抗多智能体强化学习的开源平台
items.abstract_en: Progress in robot learning, particularly physical multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), is currently challenged by a limited availability of accessible, standardized benchmarks. While simulation-based MARL has produced remarkable emergent behaviors, from coordinated team play to complex tool use, translating these advances to physical systems remains difficult. A key barrier is infrastructural: physical platforms are often prohibitively expensive, require specialized facilities, or lack open mechanisms and designs for reproducibility. We introduce KlaskTron, an open-source, low-cost (<\$2500 USD), desktop-scale robotic testbed for adversarial MARL based on the dynamic tabletop game KLASK. The platform features dual CoreXY gantries with high-torque brushless motors, enabling the high-speed, precise manipulation required for competitive play. Crucially, we provide a complete ecosystem: hardware designs (CAD, BOM), a GPU-native digital twin in NVIDIA Isaac Lab for high-fidelity modeling and simulation, and a validated sim-to-real baseline using a learned neural actuator model. We demonstrate that this baseline enables zero-shot policy transfer, with trained agents exhibiting emergent adversarial behaviors. To ensure full reproducibility of our results, all project assets are released publicly: hardware CAD/BOM and assembly documentation at [https://idscethzurich.github.io/klask_hardware], inference software stack at [https://github.com/IDSCETHZurich/klask_software] and the simulation and MARL setup at [https://github.com/IDSCETHZurich/klask_rl].

rm.usage: 开源低成本物理多智能体强化学习平台，可借鉴其“仿真训练+实物小规模验证”的闭环思路，为多机协同策略（分工、争夺控制度）提供验证载体，但它本身是桌面游戏，无法直接用于RM战场。

items.title_en: A Tightly Coupled Magnetic-Inertial SLAM System for Field Robots
items.title_zh: 面向野外机器人的紧耦合磁-惯性SLAM系统
items.abstract_en: Field robots operating in mines, tunnels, and disaster areas require reliable localization despite GNSS denial and degraded camera and LiDAR measurements caused by dust, smoke, or poor illumination. Missions involving both ground and aerial robots further motivate complementary sensing modalities that do not depend on visibility, preinstalled infrastructure, or wheel contact. This letter presents MISLAM, a tightly coupled magnetic-inertial simultaneous localization and mapping system using an IMU and a nine-magnetometer array, without relying on external odometry or platform-specific motion assumptions. The system combines the inertial navigation model with local polynomial magnetic-field models for short-term motion estimation and a global Gaussian process model for drift correction using an error-state Kalman filter. Offline evaluation on three indoor datasets collected with a handheld rig shows reductions in total endpoint closure error of 45.7% - 78.0% relative to magnetic-inertial odometry. Under poor illumination, MISLAM maintains tracking after visual-inertial odometry fails, achieving a horizontal closure error of 0.332 m, although vertical drift remains a limitation. These results support magnetic-inertial SLAM as a complementary localization modality for robotic sensor suites operating under degraded visual conditions.

rm.usage: 在GNSS拒止、视觉/激光退化的环境下用磁力计阵列+IMU做紧耦合SLAM，可作为一种哨兵备用定位思路（场地金属结构与电机磁场干扰大，需实测验证）；但硬件特殊、与赛场主流激光/视觉定位差距大，实用价值有限。

items.title_en: Behavioral Steering of Vision-Language-Action Models in the Low-Parameter Regime
items.title_zh: 低参数情形下视觉-语言-动作模型的行为引导
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly used to adapt pretrained vision-language-action models (VLAs). We investigate the problem of behavioral steering: adapting a VLA's execution style to preferences such as carrying objects higher. To investigate how little trainable capacity such steering requires and how much pretrained capability can be retained, we freeze an OpenVLA-OFT 7B policy and optimize TinyLoRA adapters with 8 to 384 trainable parameters using either policy-gradient RL (GRPO) or evolutionary search (CMA-ES). With just 256 trainable parameters, we raise carry height by 120 mm on trained tasks at 92% success and by 74 mm on a held-out task at 80% success. By rescaling the learned update, we can tune the trade-off between style gains and capability retention without retraining. Increasing adapter capacity generally improves this trade-off, retaining more pretrained capability at comparable style gains. The choice of optimizer also depends on capacity, with CMA-ES being competitive at low parameter counts, while GRPO offers better trade-offs as capacity grows. These findings show that extremely low-dimensional updates can steer pretrained VLA behavior, with adapter capacity, optimizer choice, and update scaling offering practical control over adaptation and retention.

rm.usage: 用极少可训练参数（TinyLoRA/进化搜索）对VLA做行为风格微调，属于大模型操作策略研究方向；RM自瞄与决策并不使用VLA，关联很弱。

items.title_en: VLALagBench: Understanding When and Why VLA Inference Latency Matters
items.title_zh: VLALagBench：理解VLA推理延迟何时以及为何重要
items.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models offer a promising path toward general-purpose robot manipulation. While inference latency can affect task success in a constantly evolving physical world, the relationship between latency and task success rate remains poorly understood. In this paper, we introduce VLALagBench, a comprehensive benchmark for studying VLA inference latency sensitivity across task types, object speeds, execution modes (synchronous and asynchronous), and VLA policies. Using VLALagBench, we find that even a modest inference latency of 100 ms can nearly halve task success on moving targets, with sensitivity varying substantially across tasks and policies. These differences reflect task-specific requirements for precision and continuous motion. By overlapping inference with action execution, asynchronous execution can recover some of the lost success at the cost of more frequent inference requests. Building on these findings, we develop an empirical model that predicts task success from limited calibration data, achieving root-mean-square prediction errors of only 5.7-7.8% across various VLA policies. Given an inference system's latency and per-robot throughput, these predictions guide the selection of system-specific VLA algorithm configurations to maximize task success. We believe VLALagBench and these findings provide a solid foundation for future robotics algorithm-system co-design.

items.title_en: KlaskTron-IL: A Contact-Rich Adversarial Imitation Learning Benchmark with a Validated Sim-to-Real Bridge
items.title_zh: KlaskTron-IL：一个带有经验证的仿真到现实迁移桥梁的富接触对抗模仿学习基准
items.abstract_en: KlaskTron is an open-hardware physical platform for two-player adversarial reinforcement learning, with a learned actuator model that supports zero-shot sim-to-real transfer of trained policies. Building on this platform, we contribute KlaskTron-IL: a multi-tier imitation learning dataset (80k human demonstration timesteps collected directly on the physical robot, 320k symmetry-augmented timesteps, and synthetic expert trajectories up to 5M steps generated by the zero-shot-validated PPO policy), and diagnostic baselines that expose three characteristic failure modes of standard IL methods under contact-rich adversarial dynamics: BC's data scaling plateau, GAIL's interpretable but weak-gradient discriminator (Spearman $ρ= -1.0$ peg-ball proximity recovery, but a logit span under 0.1), and an asymmetric BC-prior x reward-density interaction. Because the policy interface used throughout this paper is the same one the actuator model bridges to hardware, a policy trained on this benchmark can run unchanged on the physical robot, as we demonstrate zero-shot for the strongest BC baseline, so long as its commands respect the actuator model's $\pm 0.2$ m/s identification range.

items.title_en: MuCHMDPoser: Multiview RGB-Camera Full-Body Pose Tracking for Virtual Reality
items.title_zh: MuCHMDPoser：面向虚拟现实的多视角RGB相机全身姿态跟踪
items.abstract_en: Accurate full-body tracking in Virtual Reality (VR) is heavily underconstrained when relying solely on consumer-grade sparse sensors, such as Head-Mounted Displays (HMDs) and handheld controllers. Indeed, the self-avatar full-body pose must be inferred based on the 3 available upper-body joints tracked by these devices. This leads to significant tracking error, especially in lower-body pose. To overcome this issue, we propose to extend the tracking setup with external multiview RGB cameras. We show that integrating RGB-based pose estimation this framework is able to significantly decrease lower-body tracking errors, even under common artifacts in RGB-based estimates. Additionally, we evaluate a only-once HMD-camera calibration procedure that does not require any physical markers. We finally propose an implementation of the overall framework, achieving an end-to-end animation at 60 FPS on a Nvidia RTX3080 GPU. Codes are available at https://github.com/antmaio/MuCHMDPoser.

items.title_en: BeyondContact: A Reinforcement Learning Framework for Airflow-Based Non-Contact Manipulation
items.title_zh: BeyondContact：一种基于气流的非接触式操作的强化学习框架
items.abstract_en: Contact-based robotic manipulation is constrained by end-effector reachability and the mechanical properties of objects. Airflow can exert forces without direct robot-object contact, enabling manipulation of objects beyond the reach or when direct contact is undesirable. However, the lack of suitable simulation has hindered the application of reinforcement learning to airflow-based manipulation, limiting the broader adoption of this mechanism compared with contact-based methods. To address this gap, we developed a robot- and task-agnostic airflow extension for Isaac Lab that supports massively parallel training. The extension uses experimentally identified airflow models to compute the forces and torques exerted on objects. Based on this extension, we train a hybrid push-blow (HPB) policy that combines contact-based pushing with airflow manipulation and a rectangular reorientation (RR) policy that controls a cuboid's heading using airflow alone. To enable physical execution, we design a lightweight, high-speed blower that coexists with a gripper. In zero-shot real-world deployment, HPB achieves an 80% success rate over 20 trials, while RR achieves a mean absolute heading error of 2.6 degrees across four target headings. The project materials are available at https://github.com/iit-DLSLab/BeyondContact.

items.title_en: Bayesian Sequential Optimal Experimental Design for Single-Pixel Imaging using Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 基于强化学习的单像素成像贝叶斯序贯最优实验设计
items.abstract_en: Adaptive compressed sensing (CS) aims to select the most informative measurements sequentially, which is crucial for many modern imaging systems. This task can be formulated as a Bayesian sequential optimal experimental design (sOED) problem, where each new acquisition is chosen to maximally reduce uncertainty about the unknown image given prior information and subsequent data provided by acquisitions. However, in single-pixel imaging (SPI), the large design space consists of all possible binary illumination patterns. Directly optimizing the Bayesian sOED objective over this space using conventional methods is generally challenging. In this work, we reformulate sOED for SPI as a reinforcement learning (RL) problem. In RL, an agent learns a policy through repeated experimental trials to maximize a reward, here given as the expected information gain, the most complete measure of uncertainty reduction in Bayesian OED. This avoids the need to directly optimize complex information-theoretic objectives during a measurement to obtain the next design. Instead, the result is a learned policy function that directly maps the current posterior belief about the image to the next optimal binary measurement pattern, in a computationally efficient way. Using a simple yet representative SPI imaging scenario, this work evaluates the scalability of the learned policy under two different policy parameterizations. Furthermore, we investigate how performance deteriorates when only approximate posterior information is available or the measurements are impaired by noise, and propose several strategies to introduce additional design constraints motivated by biomedical applications. The numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed Bayesian sOED-RL framework remains robust and can be extended to more complex, large-scale SPI scenarios.

items.title_en: ReContact: Reconstruct and Retarget Human Contacts from Video for Contact-Rich Humanoid Manipulation
items.title_zh: ReContact：从视频中重建并重定向人体接触以实现接触丰富的人形机器人操作
items.abstract_en: Contact transitions allow humanoid robots to redistribute object support across the whole body, enabling manipulation beyond hand-only grasps. Human videos provide a scalable source of such transitions for robots to learn from. However, body occlusion disrupts object pose tracking and corrupts retargeted motion. Moreover, accurately reproducing the object trajectory does not ensure that the robot applies stabilizing forces at the intended contacts, risking slips or drops in later phases. To address these challenges, we propose ReContact, which reconstructs and retargets human-object interactions through an object-centric contact plan. The plan specifies contact phases, contact pairs, anchors, pressing directions, and sticking or sliding modes. Contact priors stabilize object pose reconstruction through occlusion. A residual policy over a frozen whole-body tracker is rewarded for making contact at planned anchors with forces aligned to the specified directions. In simulation, on a thigh-supported regrasp task, ReContact achieves the planned two-palm bottom hold in 83.5 of episodes over three training seeds, versus 0.16% for the best adapted baseline. One policy trained on 247 references re-solved for new placements raises in-workspace tube-transfer success from 20.4% (source reference only) to 97.8%. On a real Unitree G1, policies execute seven contact-rich manipulation and two loco-manipulation tasks.
